text.en:
Section three of Act Numbered Twenty-four hundred and twenty-seven is hereby amended to
read as follows:
"Section 3. Any contingent or unknown event, whether past or future, which may damnify a person having an
insurable interest, or create a liability against him, may be insured Marital consent, against subject to the
provisions of this chapter. The consent of the husband is not necessary for the validity of an insurance policy
taken out by a married woman on her life or that of her children."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 20, 1930.
